faq.q: How much does John V. Elmore charge?
faq.a: John V. Elmore publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does John V. Elmore offer a free consultation?
faq.a: John V. Elmore does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking.

faq.q: Where does John V. Elmore have offices?
faq.a: John V. Elmore publishes two offices, in Buffalo and Niagara Falls. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at John V. Elmore?
faq.a: John V. Elmore names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: Are the case results John V. Elmore publishes verified?
faq.a: No. John V. Elmore publishes eleven case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about John V. Elmore?
faq.a: John V. Elmore scores 47 and sits at Listed. Passed: entity registration and footprint. Did not pass: website. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and discipline. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
